thread_model.kind: compliant right-handed helical constitutive model; native implicit realization required
thread_model.coordinates: world/local common+Z up; counterclockwise positive unwrapped radians; z in metres. Frame-fixed axis. Constants zS0,thetaS0,zRel0,thetaRel0 are authored reset thread references, fixed throughout episode, not scoring targets.
thread_model.extensions: eS=(zS-zS0)-p*(thetaS-thetaS0); eN=(zN-zS-zRel0)-p*(thetaN-thetaS-thetaRel0). Clockwise rotation advances downward. N73 is coupled RELATIVE TO S, not to an independent world guide.
thread_model.loads: QS=KS*eS+DS*edotS; QN=KN*eN+DN*edotN. Frame thread applies FzS=-QS,tauS=+p*QS; nut thread applies FzN=-QN,FzS=+QN,tauN=+p*QN,tauS=-p*QN. All torques N*m, angular velocities rad/s. Equal/opposite reactions and power must be logged/verified.
thread_model.static_friction: For each thread, at zero relative speed support only the required resisting torque within +/-mu_static*abs(Q)*r. At sliding use -mu_sliding*abs(Q)*r*sign(relative omega). Screw-frame torque opposes thetaSdot; nut/screw torque opposes thetaNdot-thetaSdot and acts equally/oppositely on N/S. Dissipative work cannot be negative. Native implicit friction/constraint solve is preferred.
thread_model.regularized_solver_alternative: A declared native implicit regularization tau=-mu_sliding*abs(Q)*r*tanh(relative_omega/0.001rad_per_s) is allowed; report the choice and actual creep, force and timestep data. Do not apply explicit high-gain20Hz spring forces or pose/velocity projection. All constitutive states are native or energy-consistent physical forces, never scorer flags.
thread_model.forbidden_substitutes: No extra axial guide friction, arbitrary lock flag, target-angle servo, contact overlap pad or artificial weld may supply the required N73/cover preload or hold the target. Guide constraint friction is zero except the explicit thread law. Bearing contact/friction remains native.
thread_model.status: All coefficients are frozen benchmark assumptions. No native implementation/pass claimed.
